sources.entry: GithubListener - Simple app that will notify about new commits to watched repositories.

summary.one_liner: GithubListener is a small macOS app that shows desktop notifications when repositories you watch on GitHub get new commits.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an app that notifies the user about new commits to repositories they watch on GitHub. It requires granting access through GitHub OAuth, which the README says is needed to avoid the low rate limit for unauthorized API queries. The OAuth prompt appears once, on first application start. The README is very short and does not describe the watch-list setup, polling interval, or other settings.
use_cases: get notified about new commits in watched repos
track activity in GitHub repositories you follow
monitor upstream projects for new commits
notable: Sends notifications for new commits in watched GitHub repositories
Uses GitHub OAuth to lift the unauthenticated API rate limit
OAuth is requested once, at first launch
caveats: README is minimal; no installation or build instructions are given
Requires granting GitHub OAuth access before it works
Listed under macOS apps, so it is presumably macOS-only (inferred from the list it appears in)
